name: android-logcat
description: A pane that follows the connected Android device's logcat for the app of the current repo, colored by level like Android Studio, with a level floor and a text filter; /logcat turns it on and off.

package.title: Package
package.description: The app to follow. Empty: the applicationId of the build.gradle in the working directory.

serial.title: Device serial
serial.description: Which device when several are connected (adb devices). Empty: the first one.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: How tall the pane is when it sits above the prompt (narrow terminals).

bufferLines.title: Buffer lines
bufferLines.description: How many lines are kept for the pane and for the logcat_read tool.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language the pane draws in: en (English) or ko (Korean).
